newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ FUTURES END FIRMER ON SPECULATIVE BUYING.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ FUTURES END FIRMER ON SPECULATIVE BUYING.

text.p: FCOJ futures ended higher for the second day in a row on Thursday, bolstered by chart-driven speculative buying, traders said.
Traders said light buy-stops were touched off above 76.50 cents a lb basis September, lifting the spot contract to a high of 76.85 cents.

But a late-session round of trade selling trimmed gains, they added, and September juice settled at 76.25, up 0.65 cent per lb. November rose 0.50 cent, to 78.25 cents, while the rest of the board closed 0.30 to 0.60 cent firmer.
On the charts, September resistance was pegged at 78.00 cents, followed by 80.00 cents. Support was seen at 75.00 cents and then 73.50 cents.
Traders said the market is likely to continue to trade sideways ahead of the release of a private estimate of the 1997/98 Florida crop by Citrus Consulting International on August 14.
"Everyone's just waiting for the estimate," said one trader. "Until then it's going to be just backing and filling."
An estimated 1,900 lots changed hands on the day, traders said.
